notes.title: Patch Updates 1.26.25
notes.content:
[b]-Fixed bug causing Alpha-Skeleton to not take damage from ranged attacks

-Adjusted Skeleton Mob Health amount and damage output

-Crabs now turn in correct direction when firing ranged attacks

-When equipping shield, the health bar will now update health amount immediately 

-Health Drops Will not Pickup if health is already full (they will now time out after 2 minutes if not used)

-Fixed bug allowing player to attack boss before cutscene begins

-Fixed bug causing wolf or alpha wolf to lock in place during combat[/b]

notes.title: Patch Update 1.23.25
notes.content:
[b]-Corrected Issue Where Load Game Immediately opened Fast Travel Widget

-Adjusted Start Game Cinematics to run more smoothly

-Fixed Bug Where Bmo Blocks Character when moving

-Stopped Projectiles from passing through walls in certain areas

-Fixed error where you were unable to get tutorial sword after talking to first npc if you did not collect sword before saving

-Added New Mini Boss(s)

-Added Switch lock on target using D-pad left/right or keyboard Q/E
(and updated tutorial to accommodate additional buttons/features)

-Enhanced Hitbox on Some Enemies 

-Re-imagined/designed lock on target

-Fixed bug where boss fight music would randomly start over

-Re-adjusted Boss Mechanics and Rebalanced boss based on player data/progression

Again thank you for your feedback, I will continue to adjust things as best I can :)[/b]

notes.title: Demo Patch Updates 1.20.25
notes.content:
[b]First off. I wanted to say thank you guys for all the positive feedback. The amount of downloads have far exceeded my expectations after launch and I couldn't be more happy about that.

Many of you have reached out regarding suggestions and some bug issues. I wanted this first patch update to hopefully adjust as much as possible as I want everyone to have an enjoyable experience with my first game. I'm doing  the best I can and I'm listening to make these improvements. Here are the current patch Updates releasing later today:[/b]

-Fixed issue where enemies sometimes launch into air during combat

-Fixed Bug that potentially opens up random widget after defeating skeleton enemies

-Increased Health of Cult Mobs/Npc's

-Added Save Point Locations and Save Feature to Fast Travel Points

-Cutscene will now only play at start of game, if you have saved once it will NOT play again

-Made enclosure around Boss Fight Smaller during Final Battle

-Removed Secret Tunnel Bug, Causing players to get stuck in map

-Adjusted Crab Attack Speed to more easily be dodged

-Fixed Bug when shield is equipped level up caused decrease in health

-Fixed Bug for Esc and X buttons that caused game to Force Close

-Updated Quest Menu UI

-Added Tutorial NPC

-Added new tutorial area to help players get a better feel for controls of the game and practice
